Hi friend, Yesterday on _Meet the Press_ , [Donald Trump erupted with a fountain of lies and falsehoods about American elections](youtube.com/watch?si=KM2vSkExyTw6aUqs&t=2217&v=zYmQctYXIeM&feature=youtu.be) before abruptly walking off. Trump accused the California primary of being "rigged" and claimed "they are cheating." When interviewer Kristen Welker asked him to provide evidence for these outrageous claims, his response was simply: "All I need to do is look." Donald Trump's claims that elections are crooked, stolen, and rigged are just that: **claims without evidence.** Secretaries of state across the country, both Republican and Democrat, run clean, fair, and verifiable elections. Trump's baseless lies and false accusations sow mistrust among the American public, undermine our democracy, and have contributed to threats and violence against election officials. But Trump's administration goes beyond rhetoric. Conspiracy theorists and election deniers across the country are pushing policies that disenfranchise American citizens. This president is attacking the foundation of our democracy by encouraging gerrymandering, restricting vote-by-mail, and promoting illegal voter purge efforts designed to disenfranchise eligible Americans. **VRF stands up to these attacks by helping pass legislation to protect your right to vote and by supporting leaders who are willing to defend our democracy when it comes under attack.** But if Donald Trump and his allies are already laying the groundwork to undermine confidence in our elections again, we cannot afford to wait until the damage is done. **[That's why we're asking you The Supreme Court ruled in favor of voter suppression and against underrepresented communities in Louisiana v. Callais , folks.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
On Friday morning over 600 hundred Louisianans showed up to the Louisiana state capitol to protest and speak out against a new Congressional map proposed by the Louisiana GOP that will erase Louisiana's two black majority districts and establish all white districts.
During the hearing on redistricting, GOP State Senator Jay Morris yelled "Shut up, boy" to my Executive Director Dadrius Lanus, a Black man, who, in Sen. Morris’s words was “commenting and talking” too loudly for him to concentrate.
Sir, I am a 70 year old Black man and we know what it means to be called “Boy.”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
Senator Morris says we misheard. That the audio proves it. That he said “you all need to shut up” to the Black constituents behind him outraged that their votes won't be counted.
Senator Morris, an elected member of our legislature, thinks if he had yelled “you all need to shut up” it would be better.
It wouldn't.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that White people have been telling Black folk to “shut up" for over 250 years.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that we remember being told we were 3/5ths of a person. That even when we won personhood in the eyes of the law, they instituted poll taxes and “reading” tests. That when we marched and dreamed and cried and buried loved ones who had hung as strange fruit from tall trees because they raised their voices too loud that what Black people have always wanted is equality.
Or maybe Senator Morris does understand all that.
I don’t know.
What I do know is that I am a 70 year old Black man. And I don’t let anyone call me or my brothers “Boy.”
Please, chip in $10 or more today split between the Louisiana Democrats and Resist Reclaim Rebuild. Let’s show them that they may have gutted the Voting Rights Act and canceled our election, but we will not be silenced. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
HELP THE LOUISIANA DEMS FIGHT BACK! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
Thank you for coming to Louisiana’s aid in our time of crisis.
Louisiana Democrats

clean_body: We need your help to defend democracy during this urgent moment | Peter, When Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry declared a state of emergency and suspended his state’s primary elections in order to redraw their congressional map, it meant that 45,000 ballots would be discarded. When the Virginia Supreme Court invalidated the results of a ballot initiative to approve the state’s new map, the ruling silenced 3 million Virginians. In Alabama, after the Supreme Court gave them permission to revisit their map, officials shut down an ongoing primary election and tried to ignore the ballots already cast by thousands of voters. It’s a disturbing trend. Republicans are willing to do the once unthinkable — throwing out already-cast ballots — in order to maintain their grip on power. And this is just the beginning. These anti-democracy attacks will only get worse if we don't mount a fierce opposition to stop this ominous trend in its tracks. election.

possible: Only a small fraction of
Pennsylvanians have
truly tuned in to this election — and you’re one of them. And truthfully,
we can’t win without folks like you chipping in early and laying the
foundation for victory.

subject: Judicial Watch: FBI Records Reveal Witness Account that SWAT Officer Recovered ‘Remote Device’ from Butler Shooter’s Pocket
body:
Judicial Watch announced today that it forced the release of 48 heavily redacted pages from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit that indicate that a Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) officer at the July 2024 presidential rally for Donald Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, recovered a “gray remote device” with an antenna from would-be assassin Thomas Crooks’ pocket after he was killed.*

subject: 18 Days Until Freedom Fest 🇺🇸
body:
Get your tickets now before it's too late!
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Peter,
In just **18 DAYS** , thousands of Coloradans will gather in Castle Rock for the inaugural RMV Freedom Fest — a two-day celebration of America's 250th Birthday, Colorado's 150th Birthday, and the values that make our country worth celebrating: Faith, Family, Freedom, and the Future.
Whether you're looking for world-class speakers, live music, championship rodeo action, family activities, great food, or an unforgettable patriotic weekend, Freedom Fest has something for everyone.
**🇺🇸 FEATURED SPEAKERS INCLUDE:**
• Greg Gutfeld
• Nick Shirley
• Lara Logan
• Dr. Kevin Roberts
• Mike Davis
• Chris Wright, U.S. Secretary of Energy
• Pastor Lorenzo Sewell
• Erin Lee
• Jeremy Dys
• Kelsey Reinhardt
• Patti Fox
• Seth Keshel
• Mark Cook
• Beverly Vance Aikins ...and more.
🎵 SPECIAL EVENTS:
• Back the Blue Bash featuring Dog the Bounty Hunter
• Curtis Grimes Concert
• Championship Rodeo
• Family Fun Festival
• Mountain Majesty Gala featuring Nick Shirley, Chris Wright, and Larry Gatlin
• Spectacular Drone Show Finale
🎟️ TICKET OPTIONS 🐎 Rodeo Admission — Starting at $45 🎤 Friday Day Pass — Starting at $95 🇺🇸 Saturday Day Pass — Starting at $125 ⭐ Full Weekend Pass — Starting at $195 👮 Back the Blue Bash — Starting at $95 🏔️ Mountain Majesty Gala — Starting at $195 👑 All-Access Weekend Pass — $475 (Best Value) 💎 VIP Weekend Pass — Premium Experience
This is more than an event. It's a chance to celebrate our country, connect with fellow Coloradans, and be part of something special as America turns 250.
Tickets are available now!
🎟 GET TICKETS: _**[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
June 26-27, 2025 Douglas County Fairgrounds Castle Rock, Colorado
The RMV Team
---
[FULL WEBSITE & TICKETS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**📣 BECOME A VOLUNTEER**
If you believe in what we're building, we'd love your help.
We're currently looking for volunteers to help make Freedom Fest a success. Volunteers who commit to a single 4-hour shift will receive _**complimentary day passes for both days of the festival**_ (evening events not included), allowing you to experience Freedom Fest while helping create something truly special for Colorado. There are a limited number of spots so grab yours before it's too late!
Whether you're greeting guests, assisting vendors, helping in VIP areas, or simply lending a hand where needed, you'll play a part in building what we believe will be the largest freedom-focused celebration Colorado has ever seen.
Interested in volunteering? Reply to this email and we'll connect you with our volunteer team.
[VOLUNTEER AT FREEDOM FEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🎤 FRIDAY MAIN STAGE
**
The opening day of Freedom Festival brings some of the most powerful voices in America to the main stage.
🔹 **Lara Logan** _— Award-winning Journalist_
**🔹** **Dr. Kevin Roberts —** _President of the Heritage Foundation_ 🔹 **Beverly Vance Aikin —** _Mother of VP JD Vance_
**🔹** **Mike Davis —** _Article III_
**🔹 Seth Keshel —** _Election Integrity Expert & Anaylst_ 🔹 **Jeremy Dys —** _First Liberty Institute_ 🔹 **Kelsey Reinhardt —** _President & CEO, CatholicVote_
🔹**Patti Fox** _— Public Safety Advocate_
🔹 **Erin Lee —** _Executive Director of Protect Kids Colorado_ 🔹 **Mark Cook —** _Election Integrity Founder_
🔹 **Pastor Christine Coleman, Heidi Ganahl, Jeff Hunt & more...**
Friday daytime also includes live music, hands-on workshops, and food trucks on-site all day. This is the **Aware · Act · Advocate** experience. You won't just listen — you'll leave with a plan.
[FRIDAY DAY PASS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🚔 FRIDAY EVENING — BACK THE BLUE BASH**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Friday night is a patriotic celebration honoring the men and women who protect our communities.
**Featuring:**
• **DOG The Bounty Hunter** — _Keynote speaker_
• **Curtis Grimes Band** — _Breakout Texas country music artist_
•**District Attorney George Brauchler
** • **District Attorney Michael Allen**
• **Pastor Drake Hunter**
• **Jeff Hunt**
• Law enforcement leaders & special guests
**[General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — $95 | [VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — $150**
[BACK THE BLUE BASH](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🤠 SATURDAY — RODEO & FAMILY FUN FEST**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Saturday brings something for the whole family.
The rodeo kicks off with real Western action, followed by a Curtis Grimes concert and the Family Fun Fest — completely free for families.
**Family Fun Fest includes:**
• Bouncy Houses
• Petting Zoo
• Face Painting
• Magicians
• Sports Mascots
• Food Trucks & Live Music
**[Rodeo General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — $45 | [Rodeo VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — $295** Not into the speakers? This is your perfect Saturday.
[RODEO & FAMILY FUN FEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🎙️ SATURDAY MAIN STAGE**
Saturday afternoon is headlined by one of the biggest names in media today.
🔹 **Greg Gutfeld —** _King of Late Night, host of GUTFELD!_
__🔹**Lee Habeeb —** _Creator/Host, Our American Stories_
🔹 **Dr. James Lindsay —** _Author & Researcher_
🔹 **Pastor Lorenzo Sewell —** _Delivered the benediction at 2025 Inauguration_
🔹 **Data Republican (Jennica Pounds) —** _AI & Government Waste Investigator_
🔹 **Jacki & Noelle Caskey —** _Pro-life mother & daughter from Jeffco_ __🔹**Colorado Republican Congressional Representatives**

Gutfeld is Saturday only. If that's the one name you came for, Saturday daytime is your ticket.
[SATURDAY DAY PASS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🌟 SATURDAY EVENING — MOUNTAIN MAJESTY GALA + DRONE SHOW**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The weekend ends with a night you won't forget.
The Mountain Majesty Gala is an elegant dinner event featuring some of the most compelling voices of the weekend — capped off with a spectacular drone show finale over Castle Rock.
**Featuring:**
******•** **Secretary of Energy Chris Wright**
**•** **Nick Shirley** — _Investigative journalist and immigration fraud whistleblower_
**•** **Larry Gatlin** — _Grammy-winning country and gospel legend_
**•** **Pastor Lorenzo Sewell**
**•** Special guest from Trump's cabinet!
**[General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** — $195 | **[VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** — $995 | **[VIP + Photo Experience](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** — $1,995 (Or included with the [All-Access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) & [VIP Weekend Pass](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.))
[MOUNTAIN MAJESTY GALA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**Want to do it all?**
_**America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once.**_

This is the weekend that marks both.
**[GET YOUR TICKET NOW →](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

name: Dan Cox
subject: 72 Hours Until Final Primary Financial Report
body:
We need your rush donation to save Maryland. | | | |
---
| | |
## 72 Hours To Raise Pre-Primary Report Funds.

Dear Dan Cox for Governor,

72 hours until our report cut off... Attacks by my establishment opponent are daily now because we are strong and running to win and have reached 10 million views. And with your rush donation we can reach the final 50,000 voters we need to contact.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/Vamjs7t6FCV?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
Today, a lifelong Democrat opponent in our GOP primary sent out a massive text blast and video falsely claiming that I am a "Democrat" and have colluded with democrats. Nothing could be further from the truth.

When I was five years old I began "campaigning" for Republican Ronald Reagan with my grandparents who offered me ice cream as we drove door to door canvassing in Baltimore County. I've been elected five times as a Registered Republican and have served as both Chairman and Secretary on two County GOP Central Committees in Maryland (my County and my wife's where we lived for a time). I was elected as one of the highest votes in the Eighth Congressional District of Maryland to nominate President Trump in 2020, and served on Lawyers for Trump in Philadelphia in 2020 where we fought in federal court to stop election fraud. I've worked for Republican congressman such as Roscoe Bartlett of Maryland's Sixth District, who just turned 100 years old this week, and I've been on the staff and volunteer teams of Republican presidential candidates including Ambassador Alan Keyes, President George W. Bush and President Donald J. Trump. I campaigned for Governor's Ehrlich and Hogan. I was elected as the highest Republican vote recipient in Frederick and Carroll County's Fourth District as State Delegate as a consistent, common sense conservative.

I am the only consistent Republican conservative in this race and I've never colluded with democrats in any political race \- like my opponent is alleged to have done when he is alleged to have met with Governor Moore early on in this race. **In fact, many do not know that Ed Hale made it his ambition to un-elect Governor Ehrlich and install Gov. O'Malley, who gave us 42 taxes including the Rain Tax, took our electric clean coal power plants off-line skyrocketing our electric bills, gave us the 2013 Gun Ban and the Transgender Equity Act, which opened the "equity" door to making our schools less safe and equal for girls and women in their sports, showers and hotel rooms when they travel on sports teams.**

When his attacks that I am "too conservative" failed because I am a common sense conservative talking about kitchen table expenses we are all facing, Ed Hale has now resorted to claiming that I am a "Democrat." Ludicrous and false.

I humbly ask for your vote and your urgently needed support tonight. With your help we will win this race.
Will you rush your donation tonight? [$100, or even $1000](https://us.list-manage.com/7jbTpYjdrcj?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)? Make securely here, and thank you.

[https://dancoxforgovernor.com/donate/](https://us.list-manage.com/1AUCGv7OVj8?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

Thank you! Together we will win and make Maryland Safe, Affordable and Prosperous again.

With genuine thanks,

Dan Cox, Candidate for Governor of Maryland
Lifelong Republican

Auth: Dan Cox for Governor;
Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

body:

According to a new Elon University poll 66% of Democrats say they feel conflicted, frustrated, disappointed, or just plain indifferent about being an American.

Meanwhile, 87% of Republicans say they feel proud or grateful to be an American (we still need to get that up to 100%).

ARE YOU PROUD TO BE AN AMERICAN?

Congressman Tim Moore

## Trump Warns Israel on Iran Strikes
President Trump told reporters Monday that he warned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu he could soon be [fighting alone](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO3CAQhJ8Gd5wwYDAFRaTIUoo_bUprMeu7TbCxgDvr3j7yVenTrfaTZj7Nr6_5CyjRfv8JG_q25nnHsyZsDcvnXAqeZy7bAhXrUSDClvMshTRcGC7cHIHSe9Zd9CuiRNWh7-0onHPGjN3DDyOOUYsl6BgVokNwVvSrHUIIfbChI3-lCSNcL4TV4830MGjneotxCWocmBYYqeVy-51pbw9c0zu_sNyWvHXJP1o7KlPfmJyYnCAsl_bFmJx-7A3LDo3yDonJKdEL-fOI0LAyOVGBnf_741QLYOIf0ApE5LUV-oOVt_LcjqtDTRSZ-t4rZayWWnXFx-OklKgay7S4b0Dp49b-a9CXl38DAAD__3pLi8c) against Iran, after the two countries exchanged fire for the first time since their April ceasefire. Iran fired nearly [30 ballistic missiles](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOwyAQBNCvwV2s9UKwKSiucZdrr7QW2DicsLEwCsrfn5JfuG6kkZ4083NbbhRT3Ndv2tjWe152bmfiWrl8oi_cWi6bp5PPo1CgLecFAfUF9AXMEiim16K6YO_MyLJjO4wTGGO0nrqHVQ4GI-VVTlqSGohJouYREF1wE7ku2rcGGswAMKqp1wNdlTHDyME7OV2FAg6x5tL_5rjXB9_TKz-59D5vXbKPWo9TyC-Bs8C5tdY759-dwPm9QOCc4pMFzj69eF_XEY-1dsWGo8WU4qlHoWDdKKaPWP91w9PiXwAAAP__qJ5w_A) at Israel on Sunday night after an Israeli strike on a Hezbollah headquarters in Beirut. Israel struck back at an Iranian petrochemical plant and air defenses, giving Washington what Trump called "very late notice." Both sides [halted attacks](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-urCAYxJ8GOwx-qwgFxTZ2e9tbGpRP5V7-GMAl-_Yn7iucbpLfZDIzf1_zS1tnw_5He1Rli3PAmh2Wgukr14S1xuRXnTGfSRvtY5yBAaeMUyZno637zH1j1IYI-GhQdaNgUkrORXMoGCUzQhs2LFziKNZeDBtfxh66buEGG6vuNMaZ7Bgbe9HyTg-9lN2IZl0eYiA9Q2NLTO2_aEM5cHOf-MbUrtE3Th2lnJk8ngQmAlOttfU53IzAhIFemcB0L7lhTM4QmEq6_ElzSde-OzS0RJrQBmoDDVh0-Ojjovk22P-YaQzUJh0ITDrR5xMGHhdokjJntc7ZzEfSs91r676Vyq9-fCv4CQAA__-OJIg5) by Monday. Florida [blocked livestock imports](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAQhZ8GMyxkGJCAYBOz2XRDq4VWewfFAnasefstJ7j3AW7S1cGp7_z8eYwPoEj78hs2dHVO445niVgr5s_rM55nypuHguXIEGBLaZRCai40F3YMQPE9qia4GVHirUHXmV5Ya7Xum9V1Jng7GTsrazSiUdh1k-g1Aoqg7lND7qIJLWwnhFF9qzu4K2s7g8FPt_7OlMBANeX2b6K9rjjHd3phbn3amujWWo_Cbr-YHJgczvNsfST_TDnCHtIlYnK4qjA5zDFlCsDkcHkyOYivM0csK0eotC_8gAyFKhZeDshPjhvmBXf_5vlfRE47_yY12YXjpBipaMOUWDag-MlWfzToy8n_AQAA__8Rm4rP) from infested zones, and Canada imposed its own restrictions on Texas cattle.
